title.narrative: Responding to the Solid Waste Management Crisis in the Gaza strip

description.narrative: The project aims to urgently address the solid waste crisis and restore solid waste management services in the Gaza Strip is of paramount importance. It represents a critical component of the ongoing humanitarian response, as well as a prerequisite for early recovery and for internally displaced people to return to their homes and rebuild their lives and livelihoods as soon as the security conditions on the ground allow so. The project was designed to enhance the operational capacities of the solid waste management service providers, ensuring more effective and efficient waste collection and transfer. It focuses on controlled disposal and proper management of solid waste disposal sites, alongside restoring capabilities for the safe segregation, collection, and treatment of medical and hazardous waste. Ultimately, these efforts will strengthen the service providers operational capacities, facilitating the restoration, scaling up and sustainability of solid waste management services.
